BiblicalUsage: Half of the Manahethites is listed among the sons of Shobal, father of Kirjath-jearim, beside Haroeh. It is a clan name, a people reckoned by halves, with its resting place in the genealogy of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the half of a clan is still a people to God. The Manahethites are named in their halves, and neither half is lost.
